text:
incident-bot: SEV2 ALERT — Observability gap detected for tenant NexaHealth in private-vpc-12. Traces missing and logs partially unavailable for tenant_id=nexahealth between 2026-03-15T06:00:00Z and 2026-03-15T06:28:00Z. Trigger: no spans emitted to tracing cluster (trace-proxy-a). Paging oncall.
emily (oncall): taking. seen the alert, adding context: customer on Dedicated/VPC private control plane, traffic served from dedicated pool dpool-5. They reported an app-side error 5xx spike at ~06:05 UTC too.
keiko (customer-eng): I'm on with NexaHealth support (nexahealth-ops). They confirm they see requests succeed but no traces show up in our console and they can't access their per-tenant logs through the VPC forwarder.
raj (platform): initial guess: trace-proxy-a had a short config rollback during the 06:00 deploy window, could have dropped tenant-id enrichment header. If headers stripped, our trace-router will drop spans for tenant-scoped indexes. Pulling deploy logs.
maria (prod-eng): uploading tail of trace-proxy-a logs: ```
2026-03-15T05:59:58Z trace-proxy-a INFO reload config from s3://redwood-configs/proxies/trace-proxy-a
2026-03-15T06:00:12Z trace-proxy-a WARN tenant-header 'x-rd-tenant' missing in 3 requests
2026-03-15T06:04:05Z trace-proxy-a ERROR failed to enrich span: missing tenant metadata
```
noah (sre): also seeing metric partitions misaligned across the trace cluster; some shards show 0 write bytes for tenant nex ahealth in that interval. That matches missing spans. Logs: central-log-forwarder reported connection reset to vpc-forwarder-12 at 06:03:50Z.
emily (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) request temporary access to customer's VPC forwarder logs (we need a bundle), 2) enable fallback trace proxy (trace-shim-ephemeral) to accept un-enriched spans and tag them server-side with tenant id using IP->tenant mapping, 3) rehydrate missing traces if possible from edge gateways.
keiko (customer-eng): NexaHealth approved a temporary read-only role for redwood-forwarder-sa to pull forwarder metrics and logs. I have the signed support ticket and they just sent their bastion SSH details for a short-lived tunnel.
raj (platform): to enable trace-shim-ephemeral we need a quick config patch. I'll push a canary to trace-shim in us-east-1 that accepts spans without x-rd-tenant and uses `x-forwarded-for` -> tenant mapping. Config snippet I'm applying: ```
{ "accept_unenriched_spans": true, "ip_to_tenant_map": "/etc/tenant-mappings/ip-lookup.json", "write_mode": "tag_and_forward" }
```
maria (prod-eng): be careful: tagging server-side means we risk misattribution if IPs overlap; restrict to +10 minutes and only for NexaHealth CIDRs. I'll prepare a scoped ip-lookup entry.
samir (security): we need an audit trail. Any server-side tagging must be logged with original headers and decision reason. Also ensure keys are not exfiltrated. I'll approve with those constraints.
noah (sre): I'll open a temporary route: `kubectl port-forward svc/log-forwarder 9200:9200 -n vpc-forwarders` into a jump host inside the customer's project to pull logs. Command I ran (redacted keys): ```
ssh -i /tmp/nexa-bastion.pem ubuntu@bastion.nexahealth.internal \n  "kubectl logs -n vpc-forwarders deploy/vpc-forwarder --since=30m --tail=500" > /tmp/nexa-forwarder-tail.log
```
keiko (customer-eng): NexaHealth ops confirms we can SSH to the bastion, but will only allow scp of logs to our support bucket for 2 hours. They requested we do not make config changes without explicit approval. They verbally approved the ephemeral trace-shim if we keep it read-only for other tenants.
emily (oncall): confirm: plan = (A) ingest forwarder logs to find root cause, (B) enable trace-shim limited to NexaHealth CIDRs for 15 min, (C) replay any buffered spans from edge gateways, (D) restore original config and run a postmortem. Who's owner for replay?
raj (platform): I'll own the shim rollout. noah take the log pull. maria coordinate replay. keiko coordinate cust approvals and IAM role. samir will sign off on audit/logging bits.
noah (sre): pulled logs and uploaded hash to support bucket. snippet: ```
06:03:48.912 vpc-forwarder INFO connection reset by peer 10.14.8.22:52344 -> 10.0.4.12:443
06:03:49.103 vpc-forwarder INFO reconnect success, downstream queue flushed 0/256
06:04:00.201 vpc-forwarder ERROR auth plugin denied header "x-rd-tenant" for 3 requests
```
keiko (customer-eng): NexaHealth confirms they rotated an internal proxy at 05:59 which removed x-rd-tenant on egress. They didn't think it would matter because their app includes tenant in payload, but our trace-router requires header for routing.
maria (prod-eng): root cause confirmed: customer-side proxy change stripped tenant header, trace-proxy didn't have fallback, so spans were dropped. Impact: tracing for NexaHealth missing for ~28 minutes; logs were intermittent due to transient connection resets during rotation. No evidence of data loss in primary storage; just lost observability in the UI.
emily (oncall): mitigation status update: trace-shim canary up scoped to NexaHealth CIDRs, accepting unenriched spans and tagging. I'm toggling `accept_unenriched_spans` = true for the shim. Rolling out with `--max-ttl=900s`.
raj (platform): canary looks healthy. 120 spans rehydrated into ingestion cluster for tenant=nexahealth. Using the replay tool: ```
# replay spans from edge gateway buffer
replay-spans --source edge-buffer-12 --tenant-map /tmp/nexa-ipmap.json --limit 10000
```
noah (sre): observed traces reappear in UI for representative requests at 06:07 UTC onwards. I see 2000 rehydrated spans. Metrics: trace ingestion p95 latency spiked to 420ms during shim but settled.
samir (security): verified audit logs: shim wrote decisions to /var/log/trace-shim/tag-decisions.log and entries uploaded to audit-s3 with SHA256 hash. Good.
keiko (customer-eng): NexaHealth ops confirms traces are back in their side and they can see the missing window once we replayed. They are happy with the scoped temporary approach.
emily (oncall): next actions: 1) revert shim at 06:40 UTC (we'll keep until 06:40 for safety), 2) prepare a concise customer postmortem explaining cause (their proxy strip), mitigation taken (shim + replay), and recommended durable fix (tenant header preservation or server-side tenant enrichment with authenticated mapping), 3) schedule postmortem with NexaHealth and platform team.
maria (prod-eng): I'll draft the postmortem and include checklist item to add a fallback on trace-proxy that logs and returns a sampling of unenriched spans to a quarantine queue instead of dropping.
keiko (customer-eng): I'll coordinate the customer comms and get formal approval to run the replay and for the 40m shim window. They asked for timeline and the set of spans rehydrated.
emily (oncall): closing note: incident severity: downgraded to SEV3 — partial observability loss, no data exfil, production requests mostly served. Logging this thread and will attach action items. If anything regresses I will re-open paging. :thumbsup:
nexahealth-ops: thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll follow up from our side to avoid future proxy rotations during traffic windows.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: owners=[raj,maria,emily], impact=traces_missing, mitigation=scoped_trace_shim+replay, duration=00:28:00, postmortem_required=true
